lamp.title: 1) Provera UV lampom
lamp.content: Prvo se UV lampom proverava da li je birač već glasao.
lamp.cool_game: I have come here to chew bubblegum and kick ass... and I'm all out of bubblegum.

ID.title: 2) Provera identiteta
ID.content: Birač potom daje ličnu kartu ili pasoš kako bi se utvrdio njegov identitet.
ID.cool_game:
My name is Maximus Decimus Meridius, commander of the Armies of the North, General of the Felix Legions and loyal servant to the true emperor, Marcus Aurelius. Father to a murdered son, husband to a murdered wife.
And I will have my vengeance, in this life or the next.

List.title: 3) Birački spisak
List.content: Birački odbor zatim proverava da li se birač nalazi u biračkom spisku.
List.cool_game:
When we arrived on Kashyyyk, things were just as bad as we feared. The droids had us outgunned, outmaneuvered and outmanned by a five-to-one margin.
What none of us had counted on was the Wookiees. We'd all heard the stories of course, but we'd never fought next to them, never seen them rip apart a droid with their bare hands.
They were magnificent.

Spray.title: 4) Nevidljivi sprej
Spray.content: Biraču se na prst nanosi nevidljivi sprej.
Spray.cool_game: I find your lack of faith disturbing.

Ballot.title: 5) Glasački listić
Ballot.content: Tek nakon toga se biraču daje listić za glasanje.
Ballot.cool_game:
If you only knew
the power of the Dark Side.

Booth.title: 6) Popunjavanje glasačkog listića
Booth.content: Birač odlazi iza paravana i popunajva glasački listić.
Booth.cool_game:
I am altering the deal.
Pray I do not alter it any further.

Box.title: Think inside the box
Box.content: Nakon što birač glasačke listiće ubaci u kutije, odmah napušta biračko mesto.
Box.cool_game:
Do or do not.
There is no try.
